## c01: Arrival: street to front porch

- **Purpose:** Opening shot. Reveals the whole house at sunset, then carries the visitor from the street to the front door.
- **Start frame:** `c01-arrival/start.png` (storyboard keyframe 01)
- **End frame:** `c01-arrival/end.png` (storyboard keyframe 02)
- **Camera:** Slow dolly forward plus a gentle crane down to eye level, ending square-on to the front door
- **Duration:** 8 s
- **Matches the reference:** Reference video 0–2 s: wide establishing view of the building, then a steady push toward the entrance

**Prompt**

> Slow, steady dolly forward from the street toward the house at sunset. The black lattice front gate swings open as the camera approaches; the camera passes through it, travels up the paved driveway and gently lowers to eye level, ending centred in front of the entrance porch: square cream columns, warm downlights in the teak ceiling, the carved teak double front door, potted plants and a lit brass diya beside the stone steps. Palm fronds sway gently in the breeze.
>
> Photorealistic architectural visualization film of a luxury modern Kerala-style Indian home, like a premium real-estate launch film. Real-world materials and scale, natural light, physically accurate shadows and reflections, crisp detail, cinematic colour grade, soft evening haze. One continuous, slow, perfectly smooth stabilized camera move (gimbal or drone). No cuts.
>
> The house (identical in every shot, as in clip c01): a two-storey Kerala-style villa with warm cream plaster walls, terracotta clay-tile gable roofs, stone-clad piers and wall panels, a first-floor balcony with a black metal railing and vertical timber louvres, teak-framed windows glowing warmly, a deep entrance porch with white columns on dark granite bases, a coffered teak ceiling with downlights and a brass hanging lantern, a carved teak front door between slatted timber side panels, dark granite steps with small step lights, a cream compound wall with stone-clad gate pillars and a sliding wooden-slat gate, coconut palms and lush tropical planting.
>
